name: Amnezia
author: rem-aster
description: Turn an Amnezia (AmneziaWG/WireGuard) config on or off, switch between configs, and import new ones — all from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Connect or disconnect an Amnezia VPN config, and pick which config the switch acts on.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the panel re-reads the tunnel state and transfer counters.

schema.label: Switch on pick
schema.description: When On, picking another config while connected moves the tunnel to it right away. When Off, picking only changes what the switch will connect next.

schema.label: Connect with
schema.description: auto uses the AmneziaVPN service when its socket is there and awg-quick otherwise. daemon and quick pin the choice.
